card.name: Peak values and what follows initial doses
card.fires_on: Words that mark a maximum or peak measure (maximum, peak), or the link word after an initial dose such as followed by or and then, before the next dose amount.

modes.label: Maximum or peak measures
modes.description: The words maximum or peak describing the highest force, effect or exposure.

modes.label: Link after a starting dose
modes.description: The word by, a, or then right after a first dose, leading into the next dose step.

modes.description: The word Maintenance starting a sentence after the initial dosing.
